prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic street-style editorial photograph of a generic clearly adult East Asian woman standing on a rain-kissed New York City sidewalk. She wears an oversized double-breasted charcoal-gray blazer as a mini dress with padded shoulders, a wide black leather belt cinching the waist, bare legs and black patent leather knee-high boots. She holds a white takeaway coffee cup in her left hand and a lush bouquet of white calla lilies in her right hand. Add gold oversized chain earrings and black cat-eye sunglasses pushed up on her head. Her short dark hair is styled in a tousled effortless bob with slight waves, and she gazes off-camera with a cool unbothered expression. The background features a blurred urban streetscape with yellow taxis, traffic lights, brick buildings and wet reflective pavement. Use overcast moody daylight, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the subject, muted gray and black palette with gold accents, a Sony A7R V look, 85mm f/1.4 and 8K photorealistic detail. Preserve the source outfit, flowers, coffee, rainy New York setting and power-chic mood without reproducing Jennie or any public-figure likeness.
